## FAQ

We offer a prepaid model, where you can top up your Waterfall account, and each successful match reduces your balance. Please note, this model comes with no commitments; you are under no obligation to make regular top-ups or continue using our services. You can always return and top up your account whenever it suits you. For customers with large volumes, we can also offer monthly invoices based on the previous month's consumption - no prepayment is required.

Yes. Many of our customers are already working with other vendors when they engage with us. They simply layer Waterfall on top to maximize coverage. Since we don't require long-term contracts or upfront payments, you have the flexibility to test and use Waterfall at any time. Alternatively, we can also plug in your existing API key into your custom Waterfall.

30+ data vendors in the mix, real-time data enrichment, no long-term contracts, better TAM coverage, custom data points, and proprietary email verification algorithm. Having enriched millions of contacts for our clients, we know exactly where to source your data most effectively.

Can I develop products using Waterfall data?

We are *very* selective in partnering with platform customers, focusing on strategic alignment and responsible data use. However, once we identify a good match, we're committed to going above and beyond for our partners. This includes offering dedicated Slack support channels for both integration and ongoing needs, as well as custom data pipelines. Currently, we are powering some of the leading solutions in automated outbound and AI sales technology.
